title: write plugin config
description: Per-project settings for the write plugin, in .claude/write.json. Written by /write:setup.

language.description: The language the project writes in, such as "English". The pattern list and the checker apply to English only.

guide.description: The project's style guide: a path relative to the project root, an https:// URL, or null for the skill's defaults. The guide overrides the skill where the two disagree.

samples.description: A Markdown file of sent or published text to match, one sample per ## heading, as a path relative to the project root, or null.
